fields.title: Auction lot / reference record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of DJKN's own API JSON shape -- upstream Indonesian field names are kept verbatim. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). recordType discriminates: LOT (catalogue/office/feed row), LOT_DETAIL (full detail incl. content.barangs and photos), CATEGORY and KPKNL_OFFICE (reference mode).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search/office/lot input that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-api, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_namaLotLelangText.title: Lot name (plain text)
_namaLotLelangText.description: namaLotLelang with HTML stripped -- upstream stores markup inside the name (e.g. "30131 m<sup>2</sup>"). The original field is left untouched.

_lotUrl.title: Lot URL
_lotUrl.description: Public lelang.go.id page for this lot.

_kpknlName.title: KPKNL name
_kpknlName.description: kpknl mode only -- the office the lot was scoped to.

nilaiLimit.title: Reserve price (IDR)
nilaiLimit.description: Limit value / reserve price in rupiah.

content.title: Content
content.description: LOT_DETAIL only -- nested `barangs` (items) with ownership documents (buktiKepemilikan), specs and description, passed through as-is.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Photo objects for the lot, passed through as-is.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, office_not_found, invalid_lot_id).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across lot / reference records.
